speaker: Measurement
text: RESULTS: Abdominal_X-Ray: Dilated bowel segments with absence of gas in the rectum, suggesting a possible obstruction; Barium_Enema findings (from prior data context) indicate a transition zone in the distal colon, compatible with Hirschsprung disease.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Hirschsprung Disease

The combination of abdominal distension, feeding difficulties, and the imaging findings of dilated bowel segments with a transition zone in the distal colon are classic signs of Hirschsprung disease in an infant. I will proceed with a rectal biopsy to confirm the diagnosis.
